body_markdown:
The theme “[Maritime Excellence](https://www.imo.org/en/about/events/pages/world-maritime-theme-2026-2027.aspx) ” reflects the shared goal of creating a safe, secure, efficient and environmentally sustainable shipping industry that continually strives for improvement.


We support this commitment by investing in the next generation of maritime professionals through cadet training, mentorship and hands-on learning opportunities.


Through our cadet programs, onboard training initiatives and commitment to continuous learning, we are helping turn maritime policy into everyday practice, one future seafarer at a time.


#### Click the stories below to see how we’re putting our commitments into action.
